name: AIOProductOS
description:
AIOProductOS is a product operating system: one shared record per customer that joins revenue, feedback, product analytics, delivery work, and code. Most product stacks keep those in four tools that never meet, so "which accounts asked for this, and what are they worth?" takes a spreadsheet and an afternoon. Here it is one call.

This connector puts that spine in your assistant — 71 tools, 34 read and 37 write.

Read: the board and backlog; features, initiatives, OKRs, ideas, sprints, releases, decisions, experiments and Pages; customer insights and the Weekly Signal Memo; the support inbox, team channels and bookings; the identity graph; a live map of your codebase; and revenue-weighted analytics — NPS, NRR, funnels, retention, path analysis, roadmap drift, customer 360.

Write: create and update anything on that ladder, comment, capture insights, reply in the support inbox, post to channels, and move work through sprints — so you finish the job in chat instead of switching back to a web UI.

Three tools render an interactive app right in the conversation rather than a wall of JSON. Ask for your board and you get it grouped by status — change a status in the card and it writes back through update_task. Ask for the weekly memo and each theme carries the evidence behind it; one click turns a theme into a task linked to its feature. Ask for a funnel and you get conversion per step with the live MRR standing behind each one — the product-to-subscription join that only exists when both live on one record.

Everything is scoped to your organization and your role's permissions. One tool is destructive — delete_task — and it requires an explicit confirmation argument, so it can never fire on a task id alone.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AIOProductOS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AIOProductOS to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://platform.aioproductos.com/api/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AIOProductOS MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AIOProductOS lists 70 MCP tools, including analyze_funnel, analyze_nps, analyze_nrr, analyze_paths, capture_insight, comment_on_task, create_task, get_codebase_map, get_conversation, get_customer_360, get_device_candidates, and get_page.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AIOProductOS?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AIOProductOS in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
AIOProductOS requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
AIOProductOS is developed by AIOProductOS Inc.. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
